rules: The route list is loaded from the current PR246 CAR not_measured route entities.
Each listed route receives one real authenticated request and one anonymous request.
Authenticated outcomes use exact expected status codes; grant-gated routes use their documented non-enumerating refusal.
Responses are represented only by status, error code, byte count and SHA-256; bodies and credentials are not retained.
All state mutations target synthetic rows in the disposable local database.
Six API controller code units are included only when all of their affected CAR routes were invoked over HTTP; the web API clients are not listed as exercised.
